## Load packages and data
```{r}
#| message: false # suppresses messages that you don't need in this block
#| warning: false # suppresses warnings that you don't need in this block

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

raw <- read_csv("example_data.csv")

```

## Clean data
```{r}

data <- raw %>% mutate(example_clean=A+B)

```           

## Example plot
```{r}

ggplot(raw, aes(x=A, y=B)) + geom_point()

```
